title: Chart compare-to (previous period) leaves {current_iso_week} unshifted, so the comparison series filters the same week
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbSphdunq2aJq7ktuY

Filing gate: out-of-scope finding from the `os-dev` of #34938 (PR #35391), filed by seat 5 (area ux-1) on the seat's word. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade p3: only charts that both use the new placeholder and turn on compare-to are affected.

Blocked-by: #35391 (adds `{current_iso_week}`; the gap exists only once it merges)

## What happens

A chart's compare-to (previous period) shift rewrites date-macro placeholders to the previous window (`ui/packages/core/src/utils/compare-to.ts`). `{current_iso_week}` is a period key, not a date macro, so the shift leaves it as written and the comparison series filters the same week as the main series. Read from code; not measured in a UI.

## Expected

Either the shift maps `{current_iso_week}` to the previous ISO week key, or compare-to declines (with a stated reason) on a filter that carries a period key. Choose the smaller honest fix; do not add new public tokens.

## Done when

A pin shows the compare series does not silently repeat the current week.

Dedupe words: compare-to previous period, current_iso_week unshifted, period key compare.
